title: Nano : continous pump unreachable alert
body:
Since yesterday, I started getting Nano pump unreachable alerts, all the time. As I was testing PR4265, I thought that they were related. But, now, I'm on latest dev-d and keep getting the same alerts.

Last logs

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1761897546195.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23255065/AndroidAPS_LOG_1761897546195.log.zip)

When it started (1) is AAPS update, (2) first alert, (3) first of the pump unreachable alerts.

![Screenshot_20251031_090550_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f36365d5-d96c-4dcb-9302-72f6e58a61fd)

The latest pump unreachable liste (to give timestamps for the logs)

![Screenshot_20251031_090006_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fce4ca82-8572-416a-bc56-de1bc1befccc)

I started with Dev-d yesterday night (around 22:03) and at the moment dev-d +1 commit

![Screenshot_20251031_085142_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/07943154-6335-4bea-b5d5-30494a2a8ad4)

Loop works normally (except the errors).

I forked the dev AAPS to my GH. I change 1 file to change profile % limits. Then, regularly, I update my fork with the new commits. And browser build from there.

The problem is not related to my builds. Was working ok before.

@robertrub @MilosKozak **Nano Testresults so far:**

Confirming, pump unreachable alerts on latest dev. AAPS/Loop is not affected.

**740812ba** (FullRelease) : OK
**81e0e1b0** (FullDebug)  : OK
**e8ddd705** (FullDebug)  : Pump unreachable alerts!
**ffda40c3** (FullDebug)    : Pump unreachable alerts!
**98be85c2** (FullRelease) : Pump unreachable alerts!

Testing above only for a few hours - so needs more testing?

_Edit/remark: can't see why **commit#e8ddd705** would introduce this issue....

Hmmm.....
Noticed latest on dev commits relative long periods of non-activity on treatments Temp Basal tab? I have seen times up-to 90 minutes? Do not see this behavior for DASH.
@MilosKozak Any idea on if/why this could have changed?

For Medtrum, AAPS local alert for pump unreachable threshold suggest user to use the minimum threshold of 30 minutes. Maybe this is somehow triggering the alerts?
